---
title: "Overall survival — diagnostics"
subtitle: "Posterior and model-fit diagnostics for the Bayesian survival fits"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(posterior)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
trace_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "diagnostics", "trace-plots")
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(trace_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
```

## Convergence

```{r}
#| label: check-os-models
#| include: false

diagnostics <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main) |>
  map(function(index) {
    model <- readRDS(
      file.path(results_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
    )

    model_diagnostics <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(model)) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(imputation = index)

    rhat <- model_diagnostics$rhat
    ess_bulk <- model_diagnostics$ess_bulk
    ess_tail <- model_diagnostics$ess_tail
    if (
      any(rhat[is.finite(rhat)] > config$diagnostics$max_rhat) ||
        any(ess_bulk[is.finite(ess_bulk)] < config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) ||
        any(ess_tail[is.finite(ess_tail)] < config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)
    ) {
      stop("OS posterior diagnostics failed for imputation ", index, ".")
    }

    draws <- as_draws_array(model)
    trace_variables <- str_subset(
      variables(draws),
      "^(tx|ecog_binary|stage_binary|lung|mgps)"
    )
    if (length(trace_variables) == 0L) {
      stop("No OS regression parameters were found for trace plotting.")
    }
    save_figure(
      plot_traces(trace_draws(model, trace_variables), ncol = 2),
      file.path(trace_dir, sprintf("trace-%02d.png", index)),
      height = max(4, 1.5 * ceiling(length(trace_variables) / 2))
    )

    model_diagnostics
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

write_parquet(diagnostics, file.path(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"))
```

## Kaplan–Meier versus the standardized model curves

```{r}
#| label: build-km-model-plot
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet")) |>
  mutate(tx_plot = group_factor(tx))

km_fit <- survfit2(
  Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~ tx_plot,
  data = prepared,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)

curve_summary <- read_parquet(
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-curves.parquet")
) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(tx, time)
  )

survival_plot <- plot_km_model(
  km_fit,
  curve_summary,
  x_max = horizon_days,
  risk_every = 50
)

save_figure(
  ggsurvfit_build(survival_plot),
  file.path(figure_dir, "kaplan-meier-vs-posterior-model.png"),
  height = 6.5
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

survival_plot
```

## Residual checks

- Companion Cox model is for supplemental Schoenfeld and deviance checks only.

```{r}
#| label: companion-cox-model
#| include: false

diagnostic_data <- readRDS(
  file.path(results_dir, "imputations", "imputation-01.rds")
) |>
  complete(1) |>
  mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2)) |>
  filter(survival_time_days > 0)

cox_model <- coxph(
  Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
    tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
  data = diagnostic_data,
  x = TRUE,
  y = TRUE
)

zph <- cox.zph(cox_model, transform = "km")
zph_table <- as_tibble(zph$table) |>
  mutate(term = rownames(zph$table))

write_parquet(zph_table, file.path(results_dir, "ph-diagnostics.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cox-snell-check
#| include: false

posterior_survival <- posterior_survfit(
  readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "models", "model-01.rds")),
  newdata = diagnostic_data,
  times = "survival_time_days",
  extrapolate = FALSE,
  draws = config$diagnostics$posterior_draws,
  seed = config$seeds$diagnostics,
  return_matrix = TRUE
)
survival_draws <- as.matrix(posterior_survival[[1L]])
stopifnot(
  "Posterior survival predictions do not match the diagnostic dataset." =
    ncol(survival_draws) == nrow(diagnostic_data)
)

cox_snell_residuals <- -log(pmax(survival_draws, .Machine$double.xmin))
residual_grid <- seq(
  0,
  quantile(cox_snell_residuals, 0.99, names = FALSE),
  length.out = 200L
)

cox_snell_data <- seq_len(nrow(cox_snell_residuals)) |>
  map(function(draw) {
    residual_fit <- survfit(
      Surv(cox_snell_residuals[draw, ], diagnostic_data$event_death) ~ 1,
      stype = 2,
      ctype = 1
    )
    cumulative_hazard <- approx(
      x = c(0, residual_fit$time),
      y = c(0, residual_fit$cumhaz),
      xout = residual_grid,
      method = "constant",
      f = 0,
      rule = 2
    )$y
    tibble(residual = residual_grid, cumulative_hazard = cumulative_hazard)
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  summarise(
    median = median(cumulative_hazard),
    lower = quantile(cumulative_hazard, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(cumulative_hazard, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = residual
  )

write_parquet(
  cox_snell_data,
  file.path(results_dir, "cox-snell-posterior-summary.parquet")
)

cox_snell_plot <- ggplot(cox_snell_data, aes(x = residual, y = median)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = reference_line_colour
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior Cox–Snell residual",
    y = "Nelson–Aalen cumulative hazard"
  )

save_figure(cox_snell_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "cox-snell-residuals.png"))
```

```{r}
#| label: deviance-and-schoenfeld-residuals
#| include: false

deviance_data <- tibble(
  linear_predictor = predict(cox_model, type = "lp"),
  deviance_residual = residuals(cox_model, type = "deviance")
)

deviance_plot <- ggplot(
  deviance_data,
  aes(x = linear_predictor, y = deviance_residual)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Companion Cox-model linear predictor",
    y = "Deviance residual"
  )

save_figure(deviance_plot, file.path(figure_dir, "deviance-residuals.png"))

# Scaled Schoenfeld residuals for treatment (circles) with survival's spline
# estimate of Beta(t) and its two-standard-error band (dashed); time on the
# Kaplan–Meier scale, labelled in days.
stopifnot("tx" %in% colnames(zph$y))
tx_column <- which(colnames(zph$y) == "tx")
schoenfeld_smooth <- plot(zph, var = tx_column, plot = FALSE)
schoenfeld_curves <- tibble(
  x = schoenfeld_smooth$x,
  estimate = schoenfeld_smooth$y[, 1],
  upper = schoenfeld_smooth$y[, 2],
  lower = schoenfeld_smooth$y[, 3]
)
day_breaks <- pretty(zph$time)
day_breaks <- day_breaks[between(day_breaks, min(zph$time), max(zph$time))]
unique_times <- !duplicated(zph$x)

schoenfeld_plot <- ggplot(
  tibble(x = zph$x, residual = zph$y[, tx_column]),
  aes(x, residual)
) +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  geom_line(data = schoenfeld_curves, aes(y = estimate)) +
  geom_line(data = schoenfeld_curves, aes(y = upper), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = schoenfeld_curves, aes(y = lower), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = approx(
      zph$time[unique_times],
      zph$x[unique_times],
      xout = day_breaks
    )$y,
    labels = day_breaks
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days since random selection (Kaplan–Meier scale)",
    y = "Beta(t) for treatment"
  )

save_figure(
  schoenfeld_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "scaled-schoenfeld-residuals.png")
)
```
